test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks. If their speeds are 50 km/h and 58 km/h, find their relative speed.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the first train = 50 km/h

Speed of the second train = 58 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed of two trains running in opposite directions = Speed of the first train + Speed of the second train

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 50 km/h + 58 km/h

Relative speed = 108 km/h

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by (5)/(18)

Relative speed = 108 × (5)/(18)

Relative speed = 30 m/s

**The relative speed of the two trains is 30 m/s.**
